message: Field `ptrs` of `declare class Pointers` is a fixed-length array of `CPtr`, which has no C element layout: an element of a fixed-length array is i32, i64, u8, u16, u32, u64, f32 or f64
Field `inners` of `declare class Nested` is a fixed-length array of `Inner`, which has no C element layout: an element of a fixed-length array is i32, i64, u8, u16, u32, u64, f32 or f64
